title: Pretty!
text: Pretty!. My daughter lives in an apartment at college. Her living room walls have been pretty bare. She can't hang up things with nails, so she's been looking for something big but also light weight. She was able to hang it up with some Command strips. It has made a huge difference in her living room. She's very happy with it.

product_metadata.title: eliladis Tapestry for Bedroom Aesthetic Vincent Van Gogh Blossoming Almond Tree Wall Tapestries for Bedroom Aesthetic Living Room Home Decor 40'' × 60''
features: Material: The Vincent Van Gogh Classic Artwork (Blossoming Almond Tree) tapestry is made of 100% polyester fabric, soft texture, durable, skin-friendly, lightweight, easy to hang or pack, suitable for indoor or outdoor use.
Easy to hang: Equipped with 2 barb clips and 2 non-marking nail hooks, just fix the two ends of the vintage landscape tapestry to the wall and it can be easily installed without damaging the wall.

Design: Aesthetic tapestry is a great way to add color to rooms, beds, ceilings and walls. It uses high-definition printing and will not fade at all. Bright colors, clear lines and delicate edging add a harmonious decoration to your house.

Usage: This vintage tapestry is very suitable for wall hangings, beach throws, picnic blankets, porch hangings, tablecloths, bedspreads, sofa covers, dormitory decorations, ceiling decorations, curtains, etc. It an be used as a perfect gift for people of all ages, you will also love this aesthetic tapestry.

Easy use and care: You can hang the wall tapestry with decorative tacks or push pins easily. Dry clean or gentle hand wash in cold water to retain best quality. You can also easily iron it on low temperature.
